verified_facts.text: The hotel is set within Amsterdam's former public library.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set within Amsterdam's former public library, Andaz Amsterdam Prinsengracht is a 5-star

verified_facts.text: The hotel was designed by Dutch designer Marcel Wanders.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by renowned Dutch designer Marcel Wanders, the hotel celebrates Amsterdam's heritage through imaginative interiors, one-of-a-kind artwork

verified_facts.text: The hotel is located on the UNESCO-listed Prinsengracht canal in Amsterdam-Centrum.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the UNESCO-listed Prinsengracht canal, it's a boutique hotel in Amsterdam-Centrum

verified_facts.text: Rooms have views across the Prinsengracht canal, the Secret Garden or the observatorium-inspired atrium.
verified_facts.excerpt: With views across the Prinsengracht canal, the Secret Garden or the observatorium-inspired atrium

verified_facts.text: The Prinsengracht Suite is the hotel's signature penthouse, with a kitchenette and a private library/study.
verified_facts.excerpt: sophisticated interiors include a king bedroom with a rotating television, spacious living and dining areas, a kitchenette and a private library/study

verified_facts.text: The Prinsengracht Suite's bathroom features Marcel Wanders' signature soap bar bathtub.
verified_facts.excerpt: The oversized bathroom features Marcel Wanders' signature soap bar bathtub, a walk-in shower and an integrated TV mirror.

verified_facts.text: One room type has a private terrace overlooking the Secret Garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: A private terrace overlooking the Secret Garden sets this guestroom apart

verified_facts.text: Rooms include a complimentary minibar with non-alcoholic beverages, beer and local snacks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complimentary minibar with non-alcoholic beverages, beer and local snacks

verified_facts.text: Rooms have an open-concept bathroom with a walk-in rain shower.

verified_facts.text: Renvy is a chef-led restaurant by Randy Karman.
verified_facts.excerpt: Chef-led restaurant by Randy Karman.

verified_facts.text: Prins & Aap holds a daily Jenever Hour, a tasting of two Dutch jenevers with a brief history of the spirit.
verified_facts.excerpt: Taste two different Jenevers while our team shares a brief history, interesting facts, and the story behind each one.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's vintage saloon boat offers 60 or 90 minute canal cruises with private dining, departing right in front of the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Embark on an enchanting journey with our vintage saloon boat, awaiting your arrival right in front of the hotel. Choose between a captivating 60 or 90 minute cruise through scenic views with private dining.

verified_facts.text: Essence Spa offers tailor-made treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover pure relaxation at Essence Spa at the Andaz Amsterdam Prinsengracht. Escape the city’s hustle and indulge in tailor-made treatments

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a 24-hour fitness center.
